package.name: weigh_app_interfaces
package.description: Message definitions for LpsSaWeighApp's SCS channels, ported to ROS2/DDS. Field names/values are translated 1:1 from the real Boost-serialized SCS structs under CPM-Loader-ais/prod/common/interfaces/ -- see the comment header in each .msg for its source file. Channels already fully defined by job_mgr_interfaces/cpm_common_interfaces (JobMgr<->WeighApp shared channels) are reused from there directly, not redefined here -- see WEIGH_CHANNEL_MAPPING.md.
